provenance.basis: Descriptive upper range; Paper VI notes substantial method and regularizer dependence in width.

comparators.interpretation: The standard deviation of diameters measured over azimuth divided by mean diameter remains within the approximately circular regime discussed for the reconstructed and GRMHD images.

provenance.basis: Reconstructed distributions peak near 0.05–0.06; the paper describes most comparison GRMHD images as having fractional spread at or below approximately 0.1.

limitations: This is an independent implementation derived from the published prose and is not the original EHT image-feature extraction code.

The iterative center search, angular sampling density, radial sampling density, interpolation boundaries, and FWHM crossing implementation are explicit Vajra choices where the paper does not publish executable details.
The 38–44 microarcsecond diameter range summarizes Top Set images across methods and days; it is not an independently reviewed acceptance interval for a single fiducial April 11 reconstruction.
Fractional width is sensitive to imaging hyperparameters and the synthetic-data training beam; passing the width comparator does not independently validate those choices.
Central brightness contrast and position angle are not enforced in version 0.1 because the exact Paper IV extraction definition and FITS orientation convention have not yet been reproduced.
Passing this contract supports morphology consistency for the REC claim only and does not establish the Kerr black-hole interpretation.

method.center_estimator: Iteratively minimize the standard deviation of radial peak radii on an image smoothed with a 2 microarcsecond FWHM Gaussian.

scope: Paper-derived image-domain morphology comparison for the M87 REC claim. It does not compare visibilities, closure quantities, calibration quality, GRMHD inference, or black-hole parameters.
